component.name: AI Overview GNOME
component.summary: Spotlight-style AI launcher for GNOME (GTK4 + Libadwaita + WebKitGTK)

description.p: AI Overview GNOME is a Spotlight-style overlay for GNOME Linux built with GTK4, Libadwaita, and WebKitGTK 6.0. Query Google AI Mode, Gemini, Google Search, or Antigravity CLI from keyboard shortcuts, voice dictation, CLI arguments, stdin, or the clipboard.
